capabilities: Plot LaTeX equations as function graphs
Draw vectors from LaTeX vector notation
Compute y-values for a function and add two vectors
Plot multiple graphs or vectors separated by \newline
Configure axis labels, title, size, grid and zoom
extras: Demos are referenced but their content was removed from the provided README; vector notation must use \vec, not \overrightarrow.
motivation: The author built it for better visualisation of Math and Physics concepts.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to plot LaTeX equations or vectors as visual graphs for math and physics work.

relations.evidence: This plugin integrates FunctionPlot to use LaTeX to plot multiple graphs or vectors in Obsidian

summary: LaTeX plotting plugin that renders selected equations as function graphs or vectors via FunctionPlot, with interactive pages and configurable axes.
